semiconductor_relevance: High — Suneast Intelligent Equipment Technology specializes in manufacturing advanced equipment for semiconductor and SMT applications.
summary: Suneast Intelligent Equipment Technology provides a range of advanced equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing, including die bonding and solder reflow systems. With over 40 years of experience, they support both domestic and international clients in the electronics sector.

regional_presence.China: Suneast is one of the largest SMT and semiconductor equipment manufacturers in China, supporting the domestic chip industry.
